question: Gale & Cosm brand manufacturer company
markdown:
Gale & Cosm S.r.l.
is an
Italian manufacturer and specialty distributor of raw materials and active ingredients for the cosmetics and personal care industry
. Headquartered in Bollate (near Milan), Italy, and founded in 2000, the company specializes in naturally derived, eco-friendly cosmetic ingredients and formulations.
Tracxn
Core Business & Offerings
Product Types:
Natural-derived emulsifiers, water-soluble and dispersible oils, butter, and active skincare ingredients.
Key Lines:
Ingredients derived from organic Italian olive oil (such as the
Galolive
range), argan oil, avocado oil, mango butter, hemp oil, and globally recognized snail secretion filtrate (snail slime).
Certifications:
Many of their ingredients carry Vegan Society registration alongside COSMOS and HALAL approvals.
In-Cosmetics
Company Background
Origins:
Started out providing cosmetic active ingredients for pharmaceutical and galenic formulations to local pharmacies before expanding into raw materials and manufacturing for the broader cosmetic sector.
Knowde
Acquisition:
⁠DKSH
acquired Gale & Cosm to scale its Performance Materials life science and personal care business across European and international markets.
